title: Home Designer room layout
description: A single rectangular room: its shell, its openings and the pieces standing in it. Lengths are in the unit named by `units`; x grows east, y grows south, and an item's x/y is the centre of its footprint.

name.description: Room name shown on the plan.

units.description: Unit for every length in this file.

clearances.description: Override any default clearance limit, e.g. {"primary_walkway": 1000}. Same units as the rest of the file.

offset.description: From the west end of a north/south wall, or the north end of an east/west wall.

hinge.description: Which end of the opening the leaf pivots on; 'start' is the low-offset end.

swing.description: Doors default to 'in'; everything else to 'none'.

sill.description: Window sill height above the floor.

head.description: Window head height above the floor.

type.description: Drives the palette on the plan and which rules apply. Known values include sofa, armchair, chair, bench, stool, coffee_table, side_table, dining_table, desk, bed, nightstand, wardrobe, dresser, storage, bookshelf, media_unit, tv, appliance, counter, fireplace, plant, rug.

x.description: Centre of the footprint, east from the west wall.

y.description: Centre of the footprint, south from the north wall.

width.description: Size across the piece's own front.

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise about the centre. At 0 the piece faces north (up the plan).

height.description: Used to tell whether the piece blocks a window.

diagonal.description: Screens only: picture diagonal, for the viewing-distance check.

mounted.description: Hung on the wall, so it takes no floor space.
